name: basil chicken breast
instructions:
The basil sibling of [[mint-cilantro-chicken]] — same cut-small, marinate, pan-fry architecture, but the marinade is just basil/lemon/garlic/salt, no spice stack and NO OIL.

1. PURÉE the basil leaves with water.
2. Make the marinade: the basil purée + lemon juice + garlic + salt. NO OIL in the marinade.
3. CUT UP the chicken breast and coat it in the marinade.
4. FRY on a pan.
5. Optionally FINISH WITH PARMESAN (see notes — parmesan often appears elsewhere on the plate).
notes:
=== SIBLING — THE BASIL VARIANT OF THE INDIAN CILANTRO/MINT VERSION ===

Basically a basil variant of [[mint-cilantro-chicken]] (Priya Krishna's garlic-ginger chicken with cilantro and mint). Same bones: purée the herb marinade, slice the chicken small, fry on a pan. Different register: no ginger, no spice stack, and no oil in the marinade — just lemon juice, garlic, puréed basil + water, and salt.

=== PARMESAN FINISH — MIND THE REST OF THE PLATE ===

You can finish it with parmesan, but parmesan often appears elsewhere on the plate. So does garlic.

=== WANT TO TRY — MINT ===

Mint in the marinade alongside the basil.
